title: Fixing a list by its first coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be a coordinate, let $L$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Fixing the coordinates in the list consisting of $i$ followed by $L$ according to $x$ gives the same assignment as first fixing $i$ according to the sign encoded by $x_i$ and then fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to $x$.
